description: This header file defines API functions and overloads for marshalling and unmarshalling various types for the Abseil flags library, including support for fundamental types, optional types, and custom user-defined types via ADL.

methods.name: ParseFlag
methods.description: Template function to parse a string into a flag value of type T, invoking internal overloads.

methods.name: UnparseFlag
methods.description: Template function to convert a flag value of type T into its string representation.
